TUR.scope: Turkey 1990 player data sheet (SBB, IMF, OECD, TCMB, World Bank): central budget $25.08B revenue, $29.54B expenditure, at ~2,609 TL per US$. Income/profit tax split and the unclassified spending residual from historical 1990 consolidated-budget data.

exps.name: Domestic and external debt interest
exps.note: $4.91B (12.80tn TL, IMF). The game works out debt interest itself, so this line is skipped on import.

exps.name: Personnel expenditures
exps.note: $10.43B (27.20tn TL, IMF); includes the NATO-definition defense budget of $5.315B.

exps.name: Subsidies and transfers to SEEs and agriculture
exps.note: $4.03B (10.50tn TL, IMF): DFIF price supports, SEE duty losses, export rebates.

exps.name: Other transfers (residual to doc total)
exps.note: Doc total $29.54B less listed lines; historical 1990 other transfers to funds, local governments and SEEs.
